questions.question: Which of the following Gestalt laws is correctly defined?
options: Closure-stimuli are perceived in the most basic manner possible
Simplicity-stimuli resembling one another tend to be grouped together
Similarity - the tendency to fill in small gaps in objects
Proximity-stimuli closer to one another tend to be grouped together
questions.reference_answer:
❌ Closure：是指傾向於填補缺口，看成完整形狀（不是最基本方式）
❌ Simplicity (Prägnanz)：傾向於以最簡單的方式看待（不是相似性）
❌ Similarity：相似的刺激會被歸在一起（不是填補空隙）
✅ Proximity：靠得近的刺激會被視為一組（這定義正確）
concepts: 格式塔原則（Gestalt laws）

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT accurately reflect a distinction between classical and operant conditioning?
options: Classical conditioning entails forming an association between stimuli; operant conditioning involves forming an association between a behavior and its consequences
Classical conditioning applies to voluntary behavior, while operant conditioning applies to involuntary behavior
In the case of classical conditioning, before conditioning, an unconditioned stimulus leads to an unconditioned response; in operant conditioning reinforcement leads to an increase in behavior
In the case of classical conditioning, after conditioning, a conditioned stimulus leads to a conditioned response; in operant conditioning punishment leads to a decrease in behavior
questions.reference_answer:
這句話錯誤地反過來了兩種制約：
古典制約 (Classical conditioning)：影響不自主的（involuntary）反應，如流口水、心跳、驚嚇等（Pavlov 的狗看到鈴聲就流口水）。
操作制約 (Operant conditioning)：影響自主的（voluntary）行為，如按槓桿、完成作業、按鈴換食物（Skinner box 中老鼠按鍵獲得食物）。

其他選項正確描述了區別：
 ✅ (A) 古典制約是刺激和刺激的聯結，操作制約是行為和結果的聯結
 ✅ (C) 古典制約有無條件刺激 -> 無條件反應，操作制約強化會增加行為
 ✅ (D) 古典制約有條件刺激 -> 條件反應，操作制約懲罰會減少行為
concepts: 古典制約理論（Classical Conditioning）vs 操作制約理論（Operant Conditioning）

questions.question: Which of the following scenarios exemplify negative punishment?
options: Carly yells at her husband when he comes home drunk
Jim makes his middle-schoolers run extra laps when they are unruly in gym class
Joanie takes several ibuprofen tablets when she has a headache
Astrid tells her daughter she is grounded for misbehaving and cannot meet her friends for a week
questions.reference_answer:
負懲罰 (Negative Punishment)
 = 移除一個愉快的刺激來減少行為發生。
(A) Carly yell → 給予不愉快刺激（正懲罰）
(B) Jim加跑圈 → 給予不愉快刺激（正懲罰）
(C) Joanie吃止痛藥 → 移除不愉快刺激（負增強，不是懲罰）
✅ (D) Astrid把見朋友這個愉快的刺激移除，目的是減少不當行為，這就是負懲罰。
concepts: 操作制約理論（Operant Conditioning
questions.key_concepts: 操作制約理論（Operant Conditioning

questions.question: Rosa becomes anxious when she enters the examination room at the clinic before a blood test. She also squirms when she views injections on television. This illustrates:
questions.reference_answer:
刺激泛化 (stimulus generalization) 指一種情況：
 一個反應不只出現在原本的條件刺激，還出現在和它相似的刺激。
🔹 Rosa 的例子：
她對診所的檢查室感到焦慮（原本的條件刺激）。
她看見電視上打針也會感到不舒服（類似刺激 → 泛化）。
所以這正是刺激泛化的典型案例。

questions.question: The primacy effect refers to the fact that:
options: the most important items in a list are remembered better than the less important items
items presented early in a list are remembered better than items in the middle of the list
items presented late in a list are remembered better than items presented earlier
items in a list which have the greatest emotional impact are those with the greatest likelihood of recall
questions.reference_answer:
Primacy Effect（初始效應）：
 ➡️ 最早呈現的項目因為有更多機會被複誦與編碼進長期記憶，因此被記得較好。

Recency Effect（新近效應）：
 ➡️ 最後呈現的項目仍在短期記憶中，也容易被回憶。
concepts: 序列位置效應（serial position effect）當中的primacy effect（初始效應）
questions.key_concepts: 序列位置效應（serial position effect）當中的primacy effect（初始效應）

questions.question: Why is it so difficult to retrieve information from long-term memory?
options: The capacity of long-term memory is limited
The duration of long-term memories is limited
There is so much information being stored in long-term memory
The material that makes its way to long-term memory is temporary
questions.reference_answer:
長期記憶（long-term memory）的主要特性：
・容量幾乎無限。
・持續時間非常長（有些記憶可保存一生）。
・檢索困難的原因通常不是因為容量或持續時間的限制，而是因為儲存了太多資訊，要找到正確的線索來提取特定記憶變得困難。
concepts: 記憶的結構性特徵 Structural properties of memory（Architecture of memory systems）

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes the forgetting function that Ebbinghaus discovered?
options: Material is forgotten at a relatively slow rate at first, then the rate of forgetting speeds up
Material is forgotten at a relatively constant rate once it has been learned
Material is forgotten relatively rapidly at first, and then the rate of forgetting slows down
questions.reference_answer:
Ebbinghaus 遺忘曲線（Ebbinghaus forgetting curve）顯示：
・剛學完的東西最先忘掉最多（遺忘很快）。
・之後遺忘的速度會逐漸減緩（剩下的記憶保持比較穩定）。
concepts: 艾賓浩斯遺忘曲線 （Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve）

questions.question: "You always clam up when I ask you what's wrong," Iris tells her boyfriend. Iris is probably making this frequency judgment because she can remember a few times that her boyfriend would not tell her what was bothering him. Iris is using the ___ heuristic.
questions.reference_answer:
這題關鍵在於：
「因為她可以記起幾次男朋友不願意說的例子。」
Availability heuristic（可得性捷思）是：根據你頭腦中最容易被想起的例子，來判斷某件事的頻率或可能性。
她覺得男友「總是」這樣，其實是因為這些例子很容易被她回想起來，而非真的經常發生。

questions.question: Alyssa uses a shoe as a hammer and a butter knife as a screwdriver while making several minor household repairs. Which of the following statements best characterizes Alyssa's problem solving?
options: She is constrained by a powerful mental set
She has been released from functional fixedness
She is taking advantage of the representative heuristic
questions.reference_answer:
Functional fixedness（功能固著）是指：

questions.question: Imagine that 6-year-olds can complete a particular block design puzzle in five minutes. It takes Bailey almost eight minutes to complete the same task. In Binet's terms, Bailey's ＿＿＿ age is ＿＿＿ than six.
questions.reference_answer:
心理年齡 (mental age) 是指一個人完成測驗的表現相當於哪個年齡兒童的平均水平。
如果6歲的兒童平均5分鐘完成，而Bailey花了近8分鐘（比平均慢），這表示她的表現低於6歲水平。
因此，她的心理年齡（mental age）小於她的實際年齡（6歲）。

questions.question: Which defense mechanism is correctly matched with a definition?
options: Displacement-an unwanted feeling is redirected from a threatening individual to a less threatening one
Reaction formation-unacceptable impulses are channeled into socially acceptable activities
Sublimation— unacceptable impulses are attributed to another person
Projection— unacceptable impulses are expressed as their opposites
questions.reference_answer:
✅ (A) Displacement
 定義： 把情緒從威脅性的對象轉移到比較安全的對象
❌ (B) Reaction formation
 定義：把不可接受的衝動表現為相反的行為（不是「轉化為社會接受的活動」，那是昇華）
❌ (C) Sublimation
 定義：把不可接受的衝動轉化為社會接受的行為（例如有攻擊傾向的人去打拳擊）
（題中說「歸因於他人」，這是投射）
❌ (D) Projection
 定義：把自己不可接受的衝動歸因於別人（不是「表現為相反」）

questions.question: Which of the following statements is TRUE about emotion-focused coping?
options: Taking time-out from stress by creating positive events is a type of emotion-focused coping
Emotion-focused coping may be more effective than problem-focused coping when the situation is unchangeable
Emotion-focused coping attempts to modify the source of stress
In emotion-focused coping, a person may use wishful thinking to reduce stress or use more direct escape routes
questions.reference_answer:
✅ 情緒導向因應 (emotion-focused coping)
→ 主要目的是調整自己對壓力的情緒反應，而不是改變壓力來源。
✅ (A) Taking time-out from stress by creating positive events is a type of emotion-focused coping.
 ✔️ 正確。轉移注意、創造愉快經驗屬於情緒導向因應。
✅ (B) Emotion-focused coping may be more effective than problem-focused coping when the situation is unchangeable.
 ✔️ 也正確。當壓力源無法改變（如疾病、失去親人），情緒導向策略比問題導向更有效。
❌ (C) Emotion-focused coping attempts to modify the source of stress.
 錯誤。這是問題導向因應。
✅ (D) In emotion-focused coping, a person may use wishful thinking to reduce stress or use more direct escape routes.
 ✔️ 也正確。幻想逃避、迴避行為都是情緒導向因應的一種。
concepts: emotion-focused coping（情緒導向因應） vs problem-focused coping（問題導向因應）

questions.question: How does dissociative amnesia differ from simple amnesia?
options: Simple amnesia occurs due to stress, whereas dissociative amnesia does not
Simple amnesia involves an actual loss of memory, whereas dissociative amnesia does not
Dissociative amnesia involves an actual loss of memory, whereas simple amnesia does not
Dissociative amnesia typically results from a physiological cause, whereas simple amnesia does not
questions.reference_answer:
✅ Simple amnesia（單純性失憶）：
 通常由生理性原因引起（例如：頭部受傷、中風），導致真實的記憶損失。
✅ Dissociative amnesia（分離性失憶）：
・通常由心理壓力或創傷引起
・病人無法回憶個人資訊（例如重要事件或身份），但沒有生理性損傷

questions.question: A bystander is most likely to respond to a possible emergency when he or she is
options: in the presence of other people who are clearly not responding
unsure whether other bystanders have responded
a member of a large crowd
questions.reference_answer:
這題考的是旁觀者效應 (bystander effect)：
・當有更多人同時在場時，每個人都更可能假設別人會介入（責任分散），導致行動的機率降低。
・相反，如果只有一個人，責任就無法分散，他會感到自己必須負責，因此最可能採取行動。
concepts: Bystander Effect（旁觀者效應）

questions.question: Which of the following is not a factor that contributes to the high obedience rates in Milgram's shock studies?
options: social norms concerning implicit contracts to complete a task
questions.reference_answer:
Milgram的電擊實驗的高服從率有幾個經典原因：(A) 社會規範：實驗開始後，參與者感覺有義務完成任務。
(B) 實驗者監督：權威人物的在場監督強化了服從。
(C) 當沒有其他參與者反對時，服從更高（同儕的行為會影響決定）。
(D) 則不正確：Milgram 的研究並沒有特別強調「意識形態的正當性」（例如政治或宗教信念）來合理化電擊。研究主要依靠情境壓力、權威影響和責任分散，而非意識形態。

questions.question: Everyone in your Psychology 101 course performed very poorly on a recent exam. If your instructor makes the fundamental attribution error she would infer that the students performed poorly because
options: too many midterm exams were being given in other classes that week
the students were not very bright and were also unwilling to study
the test had too many picky items
the students were not given enough time to finish the test
questions.reference_answer:
基本歸因錯誤 (FAE) 指的是：
 👉 高估內在特質對行為的影響，低估外在情境。
也就是：當人們表現不佳時，觀察者傾向於認為「他們是懶惰、笨、不努力」，而忽略「考試太難、時間不夠、壓力太大」等情境因素。

❌(A) 太多考試（情境因素）
✅(B) 學生不聰明又不想學（內在特質歸因）
❌(C) 考題刁鑽（情境因素）
❌(D) 沒時間作答（情境因素）
concepts: 歸因理論（Attribution Theory） × 基本歸因謬誤（FAE）

questions.question: In the triangular theory of love, romantic love is
options: high on intimacy, passion, and commitment
high on passion but low on intimacy and commitment
high on passion and commitment but low on intimacy
high on passion and intimacy but low on commitment
questions.reference_answer:
（Sternberg 的三角理論）認為愛由三個元素組成：
・親密感 (Intimacy) – 情感上的接近、聯繫與關
・激情 (Passion) – 吸引與性慾望
・承諾 (Commitment) – 維持關係的意願
Romantic love（浪漫愛） 特徵：
 ✅ 高親密感
 ✅ 高激情
 ❌ 低承諾
也就是：彼此深刻連結並有強烈吸引，但未必打算長期承諾。
